capture_mode: conservative official HM Land Registry exact-price address enrichment with locality and independent address corroboration
source_note: The official HM Land Registry Price Paid Data report builder was run across all 21 priced, addressless appearances in the already banked 12 July and 13 December 2010 Savills commercial catalogue shards. Three matches were retained. Lot 1 in the July catalogue has one exact-price Southampton completion 29 days after auction, and the matched premises is independently confirmed as a retail unit. December lots 18 and 19 are consecutive Wood Green lots with consecutive 41 and 43 Pellatt Grove addresses, exact distinct hammer prices, the same completion date 35 days after auction, and the only N22 matches in their respective exact-price result sets. Eleven no-result, four ambiguous and three property-class-incompatible candidates remain unchanged. Existing evidence and every separate auction appearance are preserved.
